# Right-side SW Sector Independent Validation V4

**Final status: `NO_STABLE_DIFFERENCE`**

## Frozen contract

Expanded exploratory validation: only pure SW1/SW2/SW3 SectorStrength changes. Frozen Wyckoff, Legacy snapshot RSScore, 0.40/0.60 Opportunity weights, N>=8 gate, Top150, VP, RiskBucket, labels and T+5/T+10/T+20 are unchanged. No SW2/SW3 RS, fallback, zero-fill or tuning is used.

## Discovery Random-12

Discovery dates remain immutable and excluded: 2025-12-15, 2025-12-18, 2026-01-30, 2026-02-26, 2026-03-10, 2026-03-26, 2026-04-13, 2026-05-12, 2026-05-21, 2026-06-17, 2026-07-20, 2026-08-10. Discovery concluded `NO_STABLE_DIFFERENCE`.

## Validation sampling

one fixed-seed draw per available month, then fixed-seed least-regime-balanced draws Random seed: `20260919`.
